label: s2
prompt:
ACTION: two hands in the sleeves of a blue and white striped shirt pour water from a clear glass carafe into two empty drinking glasses on a round oak table, then one hand slides the second full glass across the table and sets it down in front of the empty chair opposite.
SHOT: close shot from slightly above, 50mm lens, very slow push of a few centimetres; the empty chair stays at the edge of the frame, softly out of focus.
PLACE: a quiet advisory room, a round pale oak table; on the table an open brown leather briefcase, a closed silver laptop, a closed leather notepad with a pen lying on it; an upholstered empty chair on the far side of the table.
LIGHT: one soft key of morning daylight from a window camera-left, about 4:1, a warm lamp glowing in the background.
SOUND: quiet room tone, the trickle of water filling the glasses, the soft knock of glass set down on wood.

label: A_s1_draft_a
prompt:
SHOT: wide, eye level, 35mm at T2.8, slow steady dolly forward of about two metres down an office aisle toward a closed door, the door centred the whole time, filling the middle third of the frame by the last second, 25 fps.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: a busy open-plan office passes on both sides: people typing at desks, two colleagues crossing in the middle distance carrying closed laptops, a woman leafing through papers; people in soft focus, seen from the side or behind.
PLACE: rows of pale wooden desks, tall green plants between them, at the end of the aisle a closed light oak door with a brushed steel handle.
LIGHT: soft morning daylight from tall windows camera-left, about 4:1, cool overhead light, expose to protect the highlights.
COLOUR: muted greys, warm oak, plant green, natural skin.
SOUND: low office tone, keyboards clicking, papers flipping, footsteps, an indistinct murmur of quiet voices, an occasional soft chime, and one high sustained tone that starts faintly and swells louder until the last frame.
